auth.welcome: Your receipts and loyalty cards, together.

scan.title: Scan
scan.prompt: What would you like to scan?

receipts.emptyMessage: Scan or import your first receipt to see it here.
receipts.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
receipts.error: Could not load receipts. Please try again.

cards.emptyMessage: Add a card to have its barcode ready at checkout.
cards.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
cards.error: Could not load loyalty cards. Please try again.

wallet.offline: Adding a card to Wallet needs an internet connection. The barcode in Dibby works offline.
wallet.failed: The card couldn't be added to Wallet. Please try again.

form.formatHelp: The type of barcode on your card. Not sure? Keep Code 128: it works for most cards. Choose EAN-13 when the barcode has 13 digits underneath, or QR for a square code.
form.offline: Adding or changing a card needs an internet connection. Your cards and their barcodes still work offline.
form.invalidStore: Enter the store's name (up to 200 characters).
form.invalidNotes: Notes can be up to 2000 characters.

invalidNumber.long: The card number can be up to 2000 characters.
invalidNumber.EAN13: An EAN-13 number has 12 or 13 digits.
invalidNumber.EAN8: An EAN-8 number has 7 or 8 digits.
invalidNumber.UPCA: A UPC-A number has 11 or 12 digits.
invalidNumber.UPCE: A UPC-E number has 6 to 8 digits.
invalidNumber.ITF: An ITF number has an even number of digits.
invalidNumber.Code39: Code 39 only takes digits, capital letters, spaces and - . $ / + %.
invalidNumber.Code128: Code 128 only takes letters, digits and common symbols, without accents or emoji.

errors.offline: You're offline. Your changes are kept: try again when you're connected.
errors.invalidNumber: The number doesn't fit this barcode type. Check the number or choose another type.
errors.unknownMerchant: This store is no longer in Dibby's list. Save again to keep it under this name, or choose another store.
errors.tooManyCards: You've reached the maximum of 500 cards. Delete a card you no longer use to add a new one.
errors.invalidNotes: Notes can be up to 2000 characters.
errors.notFound: This card no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.
errors.failed: The card couldn't be saved. Please try again.

form.checkFormat: Dibby can't show this type of barcode, so it's set to Code 128. Check the barcode below against your card, or choose another type.

detail.deleteMessage: The card and its photos are removed from Dibby on all your devices.
detail.deleteOffline: Deleting a card needs an internet connection.
detail.deleteFailed: The card couldn't be deleted. Please try again.

till.unknownFormat: This barcode type needs a newer version of Dibby. The cashier can type in the number below.

scan.title: Scan card
scan.guidance: Point at the barcode on your card
scan.chooseOne: Tap the barcode you want to use
scan.deniedMessage: To scan your card, allow Dibby to use the camera in Settings. Or type the number in yourself.

merchants.title: Store
merchants.owned: You already have a card for this store
merchants.typedHelp: Not in the list? Use the name as you typed it.
merchants.failed: The list of stores couldn't be loaded. You can still type the store's name.

photos.title: Photos
photos.help: Keep a photo of the front and back, for when the cashier wants to see the card or the back has useful text.
photos.removeMessage: The photo is removed from Dibby on all your devices when you save the card.
photos.unreadable: This image couldn't be read. Try another photo.

errors.offline: The photo couldn't be uploaded because you're offline. The card is saved: try again when you're connected.
errors.tooLarge: The photo is too large to upload.
errors.unsupported: This file couldn't be saved as a photo. Try another photo.
errors.failed: The photo couldn't be saved. The card itself is saved.

photoScan.title: Choose the barcode
photoScan.none: No barcode found in this picture. Type the number in yourself: the picture stays above the form.
photoScan.referenceHelp: Tap to zoom in and copy the number.

passImport.notStoreCard: This pass doesn't look like a loyalty card. It may be a ticket or a boarding pass: check the details before you save it.
passImport.duplicateMessage: Your {{name}} card has the same number.

errors.unreadable: Dibby can't read this file. Is it a Wallet pass (.pkpass)?
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a Wallet pass.
errors.several: This file holds several passes. Open each pass on its own to add it.
errors.noBarcode: This pass has no barcode, so Dibby can't show it at the till. It probably works with NFC only.

recognition.autoHelp: Dibby recognises the store from your card after saving. You can also choose it yourself.
recognition.pendingHelp: Dibby is recognising the store. You can already use the card.
recognition.unknownHelp: Dibby couldn't recognise the store of this card. Choose it to show its name and logo.

account.shareCardPrefixesHelp: Shares the anonymous start of your loyalty card numbers (never the whole number), so Dibby can recognise stores for everyone.

common.homeDashboardMessage: Recent receipts and monthly totals will appear here.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Dibby uses the camera to scan the barcode on your loyalty cards and to take photos of them.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock Dibby
